limitations: This preserves general WebView/installed-app QA and PDF functional checks after benchmark cleanup; recorded phase timings are not an A/B performance study.
Fifty reopen cycles occur inside one process and are not fifty independent launches.
Four generated PDF pages only; no physical printer or physical sleep and no physical mobile-device acceptance.
The installed-app desktopLifecycle scenario uses tabs; two actual OS windows are covered by the separate multi-window artifact.
